name: Chamillionaire
hook: A Houston rapper whose 'Ridin'' won a Grammy, and who said Weird Al's parody of it proved it was the rap song of the year.
blurb: Chamillionaire, born Hakeem Seriki in Washington, D.C., in 1979, moved to Houston, Texas, when he was four and grew up in Acres Homes. He made an early album, 'Get Ya Mind Correct', with his high-school classmate Paul Wall, before his solo debut 'The Sound of Revenge' (2005). His single 'Ridin'' (2006), with Krayzie Bone, went to number one in America and won the 2007 Grammy for Best Rap Performance by a Duo or Group. He made his next album, 'Ultimate Victory' (2007), without swearing once. Later he became a technology investor, including as entrepreneur in residence at Upfront Ventures from 2015.
